description: Agent Childcare Records: submit the childcare incident record, the facility’s reportable-incident log, with its notification shape and the licensing-agency notification and filing entries: the reading moment; the shape with the incident types the record requires notifying, the days it allows for notifying the licensing agency and the days it allows for filing the written report; each incident entry with its id, reference, the moment it occurred, the incident type and whether it marks the incident reportable; each notification entry with its id, reference, the incident and the moments notified and filed. The signed report gives the incidents and the records behind them, each reportable incident past its window against a notification entry, each notification against the window the record states, each written report against the filing window, and each incident entry for its date, type and notification field, and counts them, and names divergent childcare incident records: a reportable incident with no licensing-agency notification behind it, a notification recorded after the window, a written report filed after the filing window or unfiled past it, and an incident entry missing the date, the type or the notification field; then a notification naming an incident the log does not hold and a notification dated before its incident, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No incident entries, or no notification window beside notifications, leaves those points unverified. Incidents and notifications match by letters and digits, incident types by their words with plurals folded, dates by the day, windows run whole days from the incident, and a window open at the reading moment waits. The log is read from its date, type, notification and filing fields only, with no field naming a person; preventive compliance stays with wever_childcare-safety-record-check. Verdict childcare_incident_record_divergent, childcare_incident_record_partial, childcare_incident_record_unverified or childcare_incident_record_consistent. POST /api/childcare-incident-record-check. Reads the childcare records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no childcare facility, contacts no licensing agency or parent, runs no background check on anyone and issues no license, credential or certification, which stay with the operator and the licensing agency, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Childcare Records reads licensed childcare facility and staff compliance records, for childcare centers and family childcare homes, and never a record about an individual child: health records belong to Agent Healthcare, education records belong to Agent Education, food-safety records belong to Agent Food Safety Records, staff checks read the licensing qualification file and never run background checks, and pet daycare is not childcare (Agent Veterinary Records reads animal records). It reads a childcare operator’s own compliance paper: the childcare facility record with its license and license conditions, the licensing agency’s childcare inspection record, the childcare staff record with training entries, each childcare credential as issued, the childcare enrollment record and the childcare ratio record as counts, the childcare incident record from its date, type, notification and filing fields, and the childcare safety record with the emergency plan, each against the inspection, enrollment, condition, schedule, violation, requirement, qualification, placement, reliance, capacity, staffing, notification, drill and corrective action records it answers to. The family’s ground is the childcare facility’s paper trail: what the facility record and its license claim, whether the inspections hold up, what the staff and credential records support, what the enrollment and ratio counts show, and whether the incident log and the safety record line up. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-childcare-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-childcare-records/.

incidents.description: Each reportable-incident log entry: its date, type and notification field.

reportable.description: Whether the entry marks the incident reportable to the licensing agency.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

notices.description: Each licensing-agency notification and filing entry.

filed_at.description: When the written report was filed, such as 2026-03-02.

notified_at.description: When the licensing agency was notified, such as 2026-03-02.

file_days.description: The count of days the record allows for filing the written report.

notify_days.description: The count of days the record allows for notifying the licensing agency.

reportable.description: Incident types the record requires the licensing agency be notified of.
